first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person wearing a white extravehicular suit and carrying a large white rectangular backpack, changing from a transverse posture with their back to the camera to having their visor and chest facing the camera.

entities.name: black outer-space background
entities.identification: The large, nearly uniform deep-black area behind Person A and the exterior structure.

entities.name: gold foil-covered equipment assembly
entities.identification: A box-shaped device with a wrinkled, gold reflective surface and its supporting structure, located at the position Person A reaches out to touch in the final segment.

entities.name: silver-blue cylindrical module section
entities.identification: A dark-gray curved module section initially located in the right foreground and equipped with a curved orange-gold handrail; in the final segment, only part of its upper edge remains in frame.

entities.name: gray exterior bulkhead and frame
entities.identification: The horizontally extending gray panel surface, light-colored edge beam, and frame area with holes and slots behind Person A.

At frame 0, Person A has their back to the camera and extends their body transversely. The white extravehicular suit has dense folds; bent legs and thick-soled boots are exposed on the left, and the arms extend on the right. A large white rectangular backpack obscures most of the head. The backpack has a gray frame, a horizontal cylindrical component, a dark recess, and diagonal straps, while a dark-gray segmented connector hangs below the waist.

At frame 0, the gray exterior bulkhead and frame consist of horizontally segmented gray panel surfaces and light-colored edge beams. The panel surfaces have seams and fine stripes; a curved dark cable is visible on the left, and dark holes and slots and small protruding structures are present within the light-colored beam frame below.

At frame 0, the black outer-space background appears as a large, nearly uniform deep-black area above the gray exterior bulkhead and frame, with its boundary delineated by the outlines of Person A's backpack, the bulkhead, and the silver-blue cylindrical module section.
